name: Luma refill trial
request: Make this sound award-worthy. Can we say the campaign caused a 50% drop in waste? Diagnose the story, write two explanatory headlines and prepare a results card.

objectives.text: Reduce disposable cup use in the workplace cafe during the four-week trial.

sources.text: Luma installed a returnable-cup shelf beside the cafe till for 3–30 June. Staff could take a cup and return it to the shelf. The old return point was beside the rear exit. We hoped the shelf would make returning cups easier.

Disposable cups issued: 1,200 during 6 May–2 June; 900 during 3–30 June. Number of cafe purchases was not recorded. Two departments were away during part of June. Stock issued is not a count of cups discarded.
Estimated 18,000 social impressions. Method not recorded. “We cut waste by 50%” appears as draft copy, with no linked measurement.

facts.statement: Return shelf moved beside till for a four-week trial.
Cup stock issued changed from 1,200 to 900 in the listed periods.
Convenient placement may have encouraged returns.
Waste fell by 50% because of the campaign.
